column1: # What each unit calls its own voice, and for which event.
# The six events are the ones the game raises: 'selected' and 'acknowledge'
# when a player clicks a unit and orders it about, 'ready' when it comes out
# of a building, 'help' when it is struck, 'dead' when it falls, and
# 'work-complete' when a building finishes. The name in the third column is a
# name in the sound table, which is where the files live; nothing here names a
# A transcription of the Sounds = {...} blocks in scripts/units.legacy-declaration,
# bindings, which is all of them. Of the 143 types the roster holds, 121 are
# written out with a Sounds block and fourteen of those blocks are empty; the
# other 22 are the unit-dead-vision-N-M markers that units.legacy-declaration:85 builds in a
# loop, and the loop gives them Sounds = {} too. All 36 are absent from this
# file and have no voice, which is what the scripts give them.
